artworks.title: Woodland River with a Boat
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image depicts a serene landscape with a small boat on the water. The viewpoint is at eye level, providing a balanced view of the environment. The horizon is subtly suggested above the central area, where water and vegetation recede into the distance. The drawing style features delicate lines creating textures for foliage and water ripples, typical of pen and ink work. The color palette is mainly warm sepia tones, giving an aged appearance. Trees and shrubs in the foreground are intricately detailed, with a small boat carrying figures on the water. In the background, more vegetation is subtly drawn, suggesting depth and continuity of the landscape.

artworks.title: The Great Landscape with the Water Mill
artworks.medium: etching with traces of light gray and yellow watercolor on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 17.6 x 23.6 cm (6 15/16 x 9 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a village surrounded by mountains. It is viewed from a slightly elevated position, showing the landscape with distant mountain peaks along the horizon. The mountains appear lightly sketched, providing depth to the scene. Detailed linework showcases the foliage and trees in the foreground. The village is portrayed with clustered buildings, towers, and a church, all defined by fine lines that suggest architectural features. The monochrome color palette focuses on the contrast between ink and paper to create a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Fight in the Forest
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: A confrontation between a man dressed in full armor and a second hairy, nude man twice his size is drawn with delicate black lines and hatching on tan-colored paper. These two men are at the center of this horizontal drawing, and trees, shrubs, rocky formations, and pebbles on the dirt ground create the setting. The armored man is to our left. He lunges forward and holds an oversized broadsword high over his helmeted head. To our right, the larger man is covered with wavy hair from head to foot. A thick, curly beard frames his scowling mouth, and he appears to wear a helmet made of bark or leaves. He also strides forward but holds up a wooden stick, really an almost in-tact trunk of a tree, to block the knight’s blow. The bodies of three people and a broken sword lie behind the wild man.

artworks.title: Studies: Major Thomas Biddle and Thomas Wilcocks Sully
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on gray laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of sketches featuring various figures. In the top left corner, a woman is shown from the waist up, holding a child on her lap with another child standing beside her. The woman's facial features are outlined, with hair framing her face, and the children have simple characteristics. The clothing is depicted with soft shading. In the top right corner, there is another sketch of a woman holding a child. Moving to the bottom, there are two more sketches with less defined figures. One shows a woman seated with a casual posture, looking upward, while the other depicts a woman with a child where the contours are subtly indicated. The background is plain paper without any additional elements.

artworks.title: Landscape with Seated Figure and Dog
artworks.medium: black chalk and pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper, incised for transfer and blackened on verso
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image features an elevated view showing a rustic setting with a reclining figure and a dog under a sprawling tree. The horizon is low, marked by a line separating the sky from the land. Trees or shrubs are visible in the distance. The artwork uses detailed line work and cross-hatch shading for texture and depth, resembling a pen and ink or engraving style. The color scheme is monochromatic, mainly in shades of brown on a beige background. The scene includes a person wearing a hat under a large tree with a dog beside them, as well as distant hills, trees, and birds in the sky.

artworks.title: Travellers along the Crest of a Hill
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image is a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated point. In the distance, the horizon is subtly indicated by a faint line of hills or terrain. On the horizon, there are a few distant birds sketched into the sky. The artwork is composed with pencil, demonstrating soft and controlled strokes varying in density to suggest texture and shadow. Closer to us, the terrain is marked by delicate, swirling lines forming patches of vegetation and rocky formations, leading up to a line of wagons and figures farther along the path. The color palette is monochromatic, relying exclusively on natural tones to convey details and tonal contrasts.

artworks.title: Landscape with Fortress and River
artworks.artist: after Giovanni Francesco Barbieri, called Guercino
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape drawn with fine, detailed lines. In the scene, people are depicted sitting and walking on a gentle slope leading towards a bridge over a small waterway. Mountains and a distant structure with a tall spire are visible on the horizon. Closest to us is a large, round building with a dome and colonnade on the right side. Various figures are scattered throughout the scene. The sketch-like style uses sepia tones and features swirling trees on both sides.

artworks.title: Allegorical Frame with a Bat
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink over graphite, red chalk, and black chalk with touches of white chalk on light brown laid paper, with partial framing line in pen and brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Regina Slatkin in memory of Charles E. Slatkin
artworks.description: The image displays a large circular portrait of a person in the center, framed by an ornate oval border with decorative elements, including a small animal figure above it. The color palette comprises earthy tones such as light brown, cream, and dark blue-grey shades. In the foreground, there is an hourglass to the left, a small book open in the middle beneath the portrait, and a small lamp on the right, all placed on a flat surface with draped fabric.

artworks.title: Allegorical Frame with a Genius and a Veiled Woman Writing
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Regina Slatkin in memory of Charles E. Slatkin
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a reclining figure holding a large mirror at an angle. The figure has long hair and is wearing draped clothing. In the background, there is another figure with wavy hair partially emerging from a circular frame. Various abstract and architectural elements are present in the background, such as a tall obelisk and a structure on the left.

artworks.title: A Man and His Dog Resting by a Great Tree
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 16.7 x 21.1 cm (6 9/16 x 8 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Robert M. Walker
artworks.description: The image features a large, ancient tree with gnarled trunk and sprawling branches. The view appears to be at eye level with the base of the tree, showing detailed texture of bark and leaves. The horizon is barely visible beyond the tree's canopy. The illustration style is fine pen and ink with cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic with varying densities of black ink on cream-colored paper. A person in a wide-brimmed hat and a dog are seated close to the tree, resting in its shade.

artworks.title: Belshazzar's Feast
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. William Benedict
artworks.description: This print shows an enormous architectural space with a large banquet taking place. It is set in a grand, open-air hall with stone columns, archways, and decorative surfaces. At the bottom of the image, closest to us, a long table is laid with golden plates and bowls. In front of it and to the left, several people in black robes crouch on the ground, holding golden staffs and looking up to the left. Behind the table, a man in black robes stands tall, with one hand pointed to the upper left and one extended outward. A crowd of people gather around him, some bowing down on the ground and others standing, huddled close together. More people are gathered to the right. All of these people have light skin. In the background is a wide, central area surrounded by tall columns. Many people are in this space, and they appear to be bowing towards a large statue in the center of a man wrapped in a snake. The statue is surrounded by blue smoke and orange flames. More hallways with statues and kneeling figures continue into the distance. Above this open-air hall, a tall domed structure and tiered structure rise up against the dark, cloudy night. Bright, blinding light shines in from the left, illuminating the scene, cast by characters written on the wall in white.

artworks.title: Peace in the Streets
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. William Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows a large man standing in a commanding position with one hand on his hip. He has a prominent mustache, a strong jawline, and wears a helmet with a small insignia. He is dressed in a dark formal uniform with buttons down the front, a belt with a large buckle, and a chest strap leading to a side pouch. The man's expression is stern. Surrounding him are sketched figures suggesting a busy urban street scene with blurred buildings in the background.

artworks.title: Heads of a Man and a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of her parents, Sophie and Carl Boschwitz
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch portraying two individuals in profile, facing right. The person on the left wears a hat with feathers, obscuring their face, and a necklace. The person on the right has angular features and also wears a hat. Both figures are shoulder-up in the image, set against a plain background with numbers and a scribble at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Stork (Ciconia Alba)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stork on a grassy terrain. The image depicts a stork standing on a patch of grass. The stork has a long neck, long legs, light-colored plumage with darker wings, and a reddish-orange beak. The bird's feathers are intricately drawn. The background includes plants like tall blades and cattails. The illustration emphasizes the stork's elegance and poise.

artworks.title: The White Stork
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stork and an egg. The image portrays a detailed illustration of a stork and an egg. The stork is standing on one leg with its head turned slightly. The bird is illustrated with a long red beak, slender red legs, and predominantly white plumage with darker wings. Above the bird, there is an illustration of an egg suspended against a simple background. The drawing is titled with the Latin name "Ardea Ciconia."

artworks.title: Christ
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up portrait of a person with a focus on their head and shoulders. The person is facing forward with a slight turn of the head, looking slightly upward. They have detailed facial features, including expressive eyes, a long face, and slightly parted mouth. The person has long, dark hair framing their face, and there is a circular arrangement resembling thorns or spines on their head. The background is dark and textured with subtle shading variations.

artworks.title: Landscape with Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural scene with ancient columns and partially ruined structures in the distance. The viewpoint is from a lower vantage point looking slightly upward. The horizon is high in the image, extending from the water's edge to the elevated structures. The artwork is rendered in a monochromatic sepia tone with loose brushstrokes suggesting trees, ruins, and figures near the water. The color palette is limited to shades of brown, emphasizing the antiquity of the scene. Closest to the viewer, a group of figures are gathered near a small boat. Cypress trees lead towards the ruins, blending natural and man-made elements. The sky occupies the upper portion of the image, creating a sense of openness.

artworks.title: Seated Turk
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person sitting in a profile position, facing left. They have distinct facial features, a thick beard, curly hair covered by a textured turban, and are wearing detailed clothing. Details are visible on the arms and hands, while the lower body is lightly sketched. The background is plain with some discolorations on the paper, indicating an aged, hand-drawn illustration.

artworks.title: Le Départ pour le bal
artworks.description: The image shows a person striking a dynamic pose in front of a standing mirror. The individual is standing on one foot with the other raised behind them, arms positioned in ballet-like poses. They have curly hair, wear a headband with flowers, a short flowing skirt, a fitted long-sleeve top, and ballet slippers. Decorative wings are attached to their back, and they carry a quiver of arrows. The background features a textured surface and the setting suggests a dressing or performance room.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after Jean-Martial Fredou
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red and black
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a woman from the shoulders up, in profile facing right. She has delicate facial features, including a nose and chin. She has curly hair tied with a ribbon bow, and wears a lace-edged cap. She wears a dress with a ruffled neckline and floral patterns on the shoulder. There is a band around her neck. The background is simply textured with cross-hatching, bordered by a wide black decorative frame.

artworks.title: Landscape with Men Fishing by Moonlight
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Roelandt Savery
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed scene that combines nature and human activity. The horizon is shown with distant trees and rocky formations along a body of water. Sunlight shines through textured clouds, casting beams over the landscape. The brushstrokes are fine, showing intricate details in a large tree and surrounding structures. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, gray, and white. Figures are engaged in rural activities within the natural setting.

artworks.title: Castel Sant'Angelo, Rome
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of Castel Sant'Angelo in Rome. The horizon line is low, focusing on the fortress and a large flag at its peak. In the distance, smoke rises around the fortress. The etching style is detailed with fine lines showing architectural and natural features. Closest to us is a tree and people on the left side. Figures and groups of people are near the water engaged in various activities. An arched bridge leads away from the fortress, lined with structures and people. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of black and white. The scene conveys historical significance and lively everyday life around the fortress.

artworks.title: Death on Horseback
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeletal figure riding a horse while holding a trumpet. The figure is mounted on a rearing horse, draped in flowing fabric that billows in response to the motion. In one hand, the figure brandishes a large trumpet. The background features distant landscapes and other figures reacting to the central figure's presence. The drawing style conveys a sense of motion and energy.

artworks.title: Death Carrying a Child to the Right
artworks.description: This is a drawing of monstrous figures. The image depicts a creature with human-like features and skeletal limbs, carrying another figure on its back through a town square with European-style architecture. The creature has exaggerated limbs and a grotesque form, creating a surreal atmosphere. The background includes detailed sketches of rooftops and a church or castle structure, emphasizing a town setting. The drawing style is intricate with fine linework, similar to classic etching aesthetics in historical art.
